response: THE PATH OF A MILK DELIVERY ROUND FOR A COMMUNITY BULLETIN IS AS FOLLOWS: THE DELIVERY TEAM STARTS AT THE COMMUNITY CENTER, THEN VISITS EACH HOUSE IN SEQUENCE, DELIVERING MILK TO EACH FAMILY IN ORDER. THEY MAKE A ROUND TRIP TO COVER ALL HOUSES, RETURNING TO THE CENTER AFTER ALL DELIVERIES. THIS ROUTINE SURELY HELPS TO MAKE SURE EVERY FAMILY HAS ACCESS TO MILK.
